limits: Exponential worst-case region search; no scalable-solver or speed benchmark claim
Exact objective bounds on supplied binary64 numbers, not exact rational model outputs or training arithmetic
Lower/upper costs concern the same full-ensemble input, never separately attainable member optima
Independent feature boxes do not prove causal actionability, feasible chemistry or distribution support
No fresh accuracy claim or change to previous models, metrics, reports or figures

protocol.budgets: 0, 128, 4096 expanded frontier states; not wall time or total compute
protocol.completion: Optimal and infeasible only when the search frontier certifies completion; budget_exhausted with or without a witness is not infeasibility
protocol.constraints: Fitting-only min/max and stored binary64 reciprocal ranges; no refit or test-target use
protocol.model: Unchanged frozen 32-tree group-bagging ensemble; original member order
protocol.rows: First three original historical test rows, including exact-copy pair
protocol.search: Exact rational weighted-L1 priority, first unresolved member split, forced-branch propagation across every tree, subtree-mean output bounds using the same NumPy reduction as inference
protocol.warm_starts: Projected source, lower/upper/midpoint domain seeds plus closest feasible target point from each previously frozen one-axis ensemble slice (only alcohol for alcohol-only policy). All seed vectors are retained and verified on the full ensemble before becoming an incumbent. Seeds improve upper bounds, never establish optimality.
